description: RU · Other · mansurovogroup is an integrated agricultural enterprise based in Kursk Oblast, Russia. It operates across four main segments: grain cultivation and seed production, cattle farming (beef and dairy), sheep farming (wool and meat), and horse breeding at a stud farm with a 200-year history. The company emphasizes agricultural innovation and was an early adopter of precision farming technologies.
